description: The file finder opened while the conversation loads follows the conversation's directory once it arrives. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in {{DIR}}, which holds arrives-late.md; another conversation, in another directory, is there for the list to show meanwhile. The conversation list the page loads leaves /c/{{SLUG}} out, and the page's live stream and its request resolving the slug are both held back until call "release". Call "stand-in" returns "waiting" until the page has loaded the conversation list; then, if the directory of the list's most recent top-level conversation (the finder's stand-in) differs from {{DIR}}, it sets {{STAND_IN}} to it and returns "set". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open the fuzzy file finder by pressing "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier, without clicking anything first, and wait up to 10s for its input ".grp-filter" to be visible. 3. Call "stand-in" until it returns "set". 4. ".ff-dir-path" should have exactly the text "{{STAND_IN}}". 5. Fill the finder input with "arrives-late". 6. Call "release". 7. ".ff-dir-path" should come to have exactly the text "{{DIR}}". 8. The first ".grp-row" should contain "arrives-late.md". 9. The finder input should still have the value "arrives-late".
